description: Remove a webhook from your GrowSurf program by id. Returns { id, success }. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_delete_campaign_webhook

id.description: Id of the webhook that was deleted.

title: Delete Webhook
